02: FAPI statistics

Stefan Veizades

8 May 2026

1 Introduction

The objective of this notebook is to analyse the mIF data for FAP and CNN1 staining localisation

1.1 Load packages

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(broom)
library(emmeans)
library(rstatix)

1.2 Parameters

# Paths
output_path <- "../03_output/02_FAPI_statistics/"
if(!dir.exists(output_path)) dir.create(output_path)

# Functions
source("../../utils.R")
FAPI_data <- read.csv("../01_data/SALTIRE3_raw_data_formatted.csv")
ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = Age_at_Consent)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$Age_at_Consent, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$Age_at_Consent), main = "Log-transformed")

ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = TBRmax)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$TBRmax, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$TBRmax), main = "Log-transformed")

ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = CT_Calcium_Score)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$CT_Calcium_Score, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$CT_Calcium_Score), main = "Log-transformed")

ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = AVE_AV_Vmax)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$AVE_AV_Vmax, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$AVE_AV_Vmax), main = "Log-transformed")

ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = Non_Calcific_Volume)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$Non_Calcific_Volume, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$Non_Calcific_Volume), main = "Log-transformed")

ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = Calcific_Volume)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$Calcific_Volume, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$Calcific_Volume), main = "Log-transformed")

ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = Indexed_Non_Calcific_Volume)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$Indexed_Non_Calcific_Volume, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$Indexed_Non_Calcific_Volume), main = "Log-transformed")

ggplot(FAPI_data, aes(x = Indexed_Calcific_Volume)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(FAPI_data$Indexed_Calcific_Volume, main = "Raw")
hist(log1p(FAPI_data$Indexed_Calcific_Volume), main = "Log-transformed")

df_FAPI_data <- FAPI_data %>%
  mutate(
    Disease_Severity = factor(
      Disease_Severity,
      levels = c("Control", "Sclerosis", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    Sex_male = as.numeric(Sex == "Male"),
    Hypertension = factor(Hypertension),
    Hypertension_Yes = as.numeric(Hypertension == "Yes"),
    Diabetes = factor(Diabetes),
    Diabetes_Yes = as.numeric(Diabetes == "Yes"),
    Calcific_Volume_log1p = log1p(Calcific_Volume),
    CT_Calcium_Score_log1p = log1p(CT_Calcium_Score),
    Age_at_Consent_z = scale(Age_at_Consent)[,1],
    Calcific_z       = scale(Calcific_Volume_log1p)[,1],
    Non_Calcific_z   = scale(Non_Calcific_Volume)[,1],
    log_TBRmax       = log(TBRmax)
  )

df_FAPI_data_autoplaq <- df_FAPI_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Calcific_Volume))
df_trend <- df_FAPI_data %>%
  mutate(severity_score = as.numeric(Disease_Severity) - 1)

fit_trend <- lm(TBRmax ~ severity_score, data = df_trend)
summary(fit_trend)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = TBRmax ~ severity_score, data = df_trend)
## 
## Residuals:
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -0.20650 -0.07492 -0.02615  0.07490  0.34590 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)    1.208500   0.025410  47.560  < 2e-16 ***
## severity_score 0.053625   0.009129   5.874 6.55e-08 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.1117 on 93 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.2706, Adjusted R-squared:  0.2628 
## F-statistic:  34.5 on 1 and 93 DF,  p-value: 6.552e-08
tidy_model <- function(fit) broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)

tbl_trend <- tidy_model(fit_trend)

write.csv(tbl_trend, file = paste0(output_path, "Figure_3c_ASdiagnosis_FAPI_trend_stats.csv"), row.names = F)
ct <- cor.test(df_FAPI_data$AVE_AV_Vmax,
               df_FAPI_data$TBRmax,
               method = "pearson")
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2 
)

cor_table
##                                   Method Correlation  CI_lower  CI_upper      p_value  n
## cor Pearson's product-moment correlation   0.5140555 0.3486323 0.6484195 9.919052e-08 95
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3e_Vmax_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

ct <- cor.test(
  df_FAPI_data$TBRmax,
  df_FAPI_data$CT_Calcium_Score_log1p,
  method = "pearson"
)
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2 
)

cor_table
##                                   Method Correlation  CI_lower  CI_upper      p_value  n
## cor Pearson's product-moment correlation   0.5609964 0.4052759 0.6850808 3.357943e-09 95
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3d_CTcalcium_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


ct <- cor.test(
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$Non_Calcific_Volume,
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$TBRmax,
  method = "pearson"
)
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2  # df = n-2 for Pearson
)

cor_table
##                                   Method Correlation   CI_lower CI_upper   p_value  n
## cor Pearson's product-moment correlation 0.002907058 -0.2009202 0.206493 0.9779369 93
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3f_NonCalcificThickening_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

ct <- cor.test(
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$Calcific_Volume_log1p,
  df_FAPI_data_autoplaq$TBRmax,
  method = "pearson"
)
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Method      = ct$method,
  Correlation = ct$estimate,
  CI_lower    = ct$conf.int[1],
  CI_upper    = ct$conf.int[2],
  p_value     = ct$p.value,
  n           = ct$parameter + 2  # df = n-2 for Pearson
)

cor_table
##                                   Method Correlation  CI_lower CI_upper      p_value  n
## cor Pearson's product-moment correlation   0.5188533 0.3523908 0.653491 9.928888e-08 93
write.csv(x = cor_table, paste0(output_path, "Figure_3g_CalcificThickening_TBRmax_correlation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
fit <- lm(log_TBRmax ~ Age_at_Consent_z + Sex_male + Hypertension_Yes + 
          Diabetes_Yes + Calcific_z + Non_Calcific_z, 
          data = df_FAPI_data_autoplaq)
summary(fit)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = log_TBRmax ~ Age_at_Consent_z + Sex_male + Hypertension_Yes + 
##     Diabetes_Yes + Calcific_z + Non_Calcific_z, data = df_FAPI_data_autoplaq)
## 
## Residuals:
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -0.14310 -0.05624 -0.02608  0.05490  0.21793 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                    Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)       0.2931072  0.0200968  14.585  < 2e-16 ***
## Age_at_Consent_z -0.0002635  0.0086875  -0.030    0.976    
## Sex_male         -0.0130220  0.0199799  -0.652    0.516    
## Hypertension_Yes  0.0026107  0.0177851   0.147    0.884    
## Diabetes_Yes      0.0231475  0.0242337   0.955    0.342    
## Calcific_z        0.0504445  0.0089149   5.658 1.97e-07 ***
## Non_Calcific_z   -0.0037448  0.0091647  -0.409    0.684    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.08186 on 86 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.2988, Adjusted R-squared:  0.2499 
## F-statistic: 6.107 on 6 and 86 DF,  p-value: 2.312e-05
# Visual
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(fit)

# Formal tests
shapiro.test(resid(fit))           # normality
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  resid(fit)
## W = 0.95788, p-value = 0.004391
library(car)
vif(fit)                           # collinearity
## Age_at_Consent_z         Sex_male Hypertension_Yes     Diabetes_Yes       Calcific_z   Non_Calcific_z 
##         1.050430         1.188876         1.068907         1.042238         1.091114         1.153118
library(lmtest)
bptest(fit)                        # heteroscedasticity
## 
##  studentized Breusch-Pagan test
## 
## data:  fit
## BP = 11.065, df = 6, p-value = 0.08638
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
robust <- coeftest(fit, vcov = vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3"))
robust
## 
## t test of coefficients:
## 
##                     Estimate  Std. Error t value  Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)       0.29310717  0.02515301 11.6530 < 2.2e-16 ***
## Age_at_Consent_z -0.00026352  0.00910890 -0.0289    0.9770    
## Sex_male         -0.01302197  0.02255769 -0.5773    0.5653    
## Hypertension_Yes  0.00261071  0.01909558  0.1367    0.8916    
## Diabetes_Yes      0.02314751  0.02262164  1.0232    0.3091    
## Calcific_z        0.05044452  0.00914051  5.5188 3.548e-07 ***
## Non_Calcific_z   -0.00374476  0.00964422 -0.3883    0.6988    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
robust_tidy <- broom::tidy(robust, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      term == "Age_at_Consent_z" ~ "Age",
      term == "Sex_male"         ~ "Male sex",
      term == "Hypertension_Yes" ~ "Hypertension",
      term == "Diabetes_Yes"     ~ "Diabetes",
      term == "Calcific_z"       ~ "Calcific volume",
      term == "Non_Calcific_z"   ~ "Non-calcific volume"
    ),
    `β (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f to %.3f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    P = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
  )

# Final table
robust_tidy %>% select(label, `β (95% CI)`, P)
## # A tibble: 6 × 3
##   label               `β (95% CI)`             P     
##   <chr>               <chr>                    <chr> 
## 1 Age                 -0.000 (-0.018 to 0.018) 0.977 
## 2 Male sex            -0.013 (-0.058 to 0.032) 0.565 
## 3 Hypertension        0.003 (-0.035 to 0.041)  0.892 
## 4 Diabetes            0.023 (-0.022 to 0.068)  0.309 
## 5 Calcific volume     0.050 (0.032 to 0.069)   <0.001
## 6 Non-calcific volume -0.004 (-0.023 to 0.015) 0.699
cat(sprintf(
  "n = %d; Adjusted R² = %.3f; F-test P = %.2e; all VIF < %.1f\nOutcome: log(TBRmax). Calcific and non-calcific volumes log-transformed prior to standardisation. HC3 robust standard errors.",
  nobs(fit),
  summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
  pf(summary(fit)$fstatistic[1], summary(fit)$fstatistic[2],
     summary(fit)$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE),
  max(vif(fit))
))
## n = 93; Adjusted R² = 0.250; F-test P = 2.31e-05; all VIF < 1.2
## Outcome: log(TBRmax). Calcific and non-calcific volumes log-transformed prior to standardisation. HC3 robust standard errors.
library(openxlsx)
# Build the table
tbl_out <- robust_tidy %>% select(label, `β (95% CI)`, P)

# Build the footnote
footnote <- sprintf(
  "n = %d; Adjusted R² = %.3f; F-test P = %.2e; all VIF < %.1f. Outcome: log(TBRmax). Calcific volume log-transformed prior to standardisation. HC3 robust standard errors.",
  nobs(fit),
  summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
  pf(summary(fit)$fstatistic[1], summary(fit)$fstatistic[2],
     summary(fit)$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE),
  max(vif(fit))
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "MVA")
writeData(wb, "MVA", tbl_out)
writeData(wb, "MVA", footnote, startRow = nrow(tbl_out) + 2, startCol = 1)

# Style the footnote row
addStyle(wb, "MVA",
         style = createStyle(fontSize = 9, textDecoration = "italic"),
         rows = nrow(tbl_out) + 2, cols = 1)

saveWorkbook(wb, paste0(output_path, "Supplemental_Table_7_TBRmax_MVA.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
